variant.title: Multiset Equality Operator Fixture
variant.description: A technical reference for two groups containing the same digit frequencies in any order.
rule_guide.title: Multiset Reference Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: The two specified groups must contain the same digits with the same occurrence counts.
rule_guide.item_3: The positions may differ; only each digit's frequency in the two groups is compared.
